Robinson Stadium

Pasadena, California

Rose City FC will play home games at the historic Robinson Stadium. With 4,599 seats to choose from, there are no bad views while watching the match.

In 2001, Pasadena City College named Robinson Stadium after the legendary Jackie and Mack Robinson. The Robinson brothers moved to Pasadena with their mother in 1920. Jackie, then one year old, and Mack, four years older, lived on Pepper Street. They attended John Muir High School and later Pasadena Junior College, now known as Pasadena City College. Jackie was inducted into the National Baseball Hall of Fame in July 1962. His iconic #42 jersey is retired league-wide. Mack finished second in the 200-meter final at the 1936 Olympics, just four-tenths of a second behind Jesse Owens. Mack was inducted into the UO Hall of Fame in 1995. The City of Pasadena has memorialized Jackie and Mack Robinson with two monumental bronze portrait heads situated across from City Hall in Pasadena, California.

“People just don’t realize how much sports history we have in Pasadena. We’ve had over 16 athletes go pro just in soccer. I tell people all the time Pasadena is the greatest city in the world. We have the Rose Bowl, Rose Parade, museums, Caltech, and NASA’s JPL all in our backyard. We even have a United States Navy submarine named after us called the USS Pasadena (SSN-752). To have Rose City FC play at Robinson Stadium is super exciting for us, and we can’t wait till kickoff!”

– GM Samuel Whitworth

Directions By Foothill Transit

Getting to Rose City FC games at Robinson Stadium is easy with Foothill Transit.

Take Line 187 to Colorado Blvd and Sierra Bonita Ave E.

The Line 187 stop at Colorado Blvd and Sierra Bonita Ave E is in front of Pasadena City College.

The stadium is about a five-minute walk from the bus stop.

Parking Lot No. 5

You may purchase daily parking permits for $2.00 a day from the yellow parking permit machines located on every level of the parking lots throughout the main and CEC campuses. All daily parking permit machines accept $1 bills.

Parking Lot No. 5 is on S. Bonnie Ave.

Line 187: Azusa – Arcadia – Pasadena

Line 187 serves Pasadena, East Pasadena, East San Gabriel, Arcadia, Monrovia, Duarte, Irwindale, and Azusa.

Visit one of the many popular destinations located along Line 187, such as Old Town Pasadena, Pacific Asia Museum, California School of Culinary Arts, Target, Paul Mitchell the School, North-West College–Pasadena, Pasadena City College, Pasadena YMCA, Pasadena City College – Community Education Center, Vons, Michillinda Park, Ralphs, Sprouts Farmers Market, Grocery Outlet, H Mart, The Shops at Santa Anita, Methodist Hospital of Southern California, Santa Anita Golf Course, Arcadia Community Regional Park, Santa Anita Race Track, Girl Scouts of Greater Los Angeles – Central Region – Arcadia Service Center, Arcadia Adult School, Baja Ranch, Mt. Sierra College, Old Town Monrovia, Monrovia Community Adult School, Opportunities for Learning, Smart & Final, Tropicana Market, City of Duarte Parks and Recreation Department, Costco, and the Santa Fe Dam Recreational Area.
